admission.justification: Realized across paseoFrameControl.ts and paseoFrameModel.ts; prevents timeout notices from claiming a reload occurred when the in-flight frame was kept open.

applicability: A wanted but unsettled selection whose post-onLoad ready report, 45 s cold-load cap, or open-request answer is overdue, on document and Chats pages.
conditions: A first post-onLoad or open-request deadline probes the application; an unanswered open-request ping permits one fallback load, while post-load ping silence or the 45 s cold-load cap settles unavailable without reloading.
The timeout sentence reflects truthfully whether the loaded identity already names the selected agent, the frame was kept open for a late answer, or an open-request fallback loaded its page.
A pong preserves or reestablishes readiness and a responsive late answer remains waiting.
exclusions: Unselected panes, which name nothing by construction.

evidence: PaseoChatFrame.test.tsx document page: no-ready naming, no-target silence, chats-page single fallback load with truthful sentence

statement: Post-onLoad readiness timeout or agent-answer timeout sends ping. Only an unanswered open-request ping loads the URL fallback once and states whether it loaded the agent's page or already named it; an unanswered post-load ping or the 45 s cold-load cap settles unavailable without reloading and states whether the frame already named the agent or was kept open for a late answer. A pong preserves or reestablishes readiness; a slow answer remains a named waiting state with explicit Retry and no automatic load.
title: Timeout probes and truthful problem copy for load versus open silence
